window.tail: drop incomplete final span; record tail ticks
window.filtering: none; complete inclusive native streams, including pauses and idle

split_policy: frozen historical T and V roles; never recompute hash split over a changed corpus
logical_hash_contract: SHA256 of C-order little-endian float32 values; no NumPy header

smooth_teacher.future: smooth concatenated last-128-prefix + 800-future, retain future side
smooth_teacher.view_sampler: np.random.default_rng([seed, epoch]): draw one uniform w3/w5 choice per compact row before row permutation
